# Anne Shirley

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 years old initially, growing into young adulthood  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c6 P17](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0017), [v2 c10 P3](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c6 P14](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0014)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** School teacher at Avonlea School  <sub>[v1 c38 P36](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0036), [v2 c6 P3](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0003)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Anne Shirley  <sub>[v1 c22 P1](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Cordelia  <sub>[v1 c3 P15](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0015), [v1 c17 P33](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0033)</sub>; Carrots  <sub>[v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Anne is a slender girl with freckles across her nose and long red braids, which she thoroughly dislikes and once tried to dye green. She has a pointed chin and large, dark blue or gray eyes that spark with emotion. People's views on her looks vary, though she maintains a lithe, girlish shape as she grows up.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015), [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c28 P24](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0024), [v2 c3 P48](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0048), [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c27 P41](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0041)_

## Personality

Anne is an imaginative, highly expressive, and passionate individual who loves beauty and romance. She is deeply loyal to her friends and possesses a strong temper that can flare up dramatically when insulted. She holds high artistic ideals, frequently seeks out kindred spirits, and has a strong tenacity for both her loves and her grudges.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P17](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0017), [v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015), [v1 c9 P41](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0041), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c28 P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v2 c1 P27](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0027), [v2 c3 P42](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0042), [v2 c7 P15](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0015)_

## History

Anne Shirley was born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia, to high school teacher Walter Shirley and his wife Bertha. After an orphan childhood, she arrived at Green Gables, where Marilla and Matthew Cuthbert mistakenly received her instead of the boy they had requested. Though initially facing the prospect of being sent away or given to Mrs. Blewett, she was allowed to stay. Soon after arriving in Avonlea, she formed a close friendship with Diana Barry and developed a intense rivalry with Gilbert Blythe after he called her "Carrots." She attended Avonlea school under Mr. Phillips and later Miss Stacy, joining the Queen's preparation class. She excelled academically, winning the Avery scholarship at Queen's Academy. Upon completing her studies, she chose to forego college to remain at Green Gables, taking up a teaching position at Avonlea School and serving as secretary for the Avonlea Village Improvement Society.
